notes: DOCUMENTED TARGET (cell is frozen, daemon=incapable — no recording is taken). Copilot CLI 1.0.77 really does burn a subscription window down: schemas/session-events.schema.json → AssistantUsageQuotaSnapshot carries isUnlimitedEntitlement / entitlementRequests / usedRequests / remainingPercentage / resetDate, and app.js renders it as "<used> / <limit> AIC" (the /usage surface). It is NEVER persisted: AssistantUsageEvent — the only carrier of quotaSnapshots — is marked `ephemeral: {const: true, description: "Always true for events that are transient and not persisted to the session event log on disk"}`, as are SessionLimitsExhaustedRequestedEvent (usedAiCredits/maxAiCredits) and UsageInfoEvent (tokenLimit). A live 6-session / 13-turn 1.0.77 corpus confirms it: zero occurrences of assistant.usage, quotaSnapshots, remainingPercentage, entitlementRequests, usedAiCredits or session.usage_info in any events.jsonl, and not one session.session_limits_changed. What IS persisted is cumulative CONSUMPTION with no denominator — session.usage_checkpoint / session.shutdown totalNanoAiu + totalPremiumRequests (observed rising 573625000 → 744650000 → 833330000 → 899470000 nanoAiu, premium 0.33 → 0.66 → 0.99 → 1.32, across one 5-turn session). irrlicht's RateLimitWindow.UsedPercent is documented as the PROVIDER-REPORTED utilization (core/domain/session/rate_limit.go:42-56) and the reference codex parser reads used_percent directly rather than deriving it, so a numerator alone cannot populate it — and the #1256 maintainer decision explicitly forbids reconstructing a quota from a multiplier. The copilot adapter accordingly sets no part of the rate-limit surface (`grep -rn RateLimit core/adapters/inbound/agents/copilot/` → zero hits), so RateLimit / RateLimitHistory / ForecastCap are empty for every copilot session and the burndown_t1/t2/t3 phases below have nothing to assert over. This spec is retained as the target a recording WOULD validate should GitHub flip AssistantUsageEvent off `ephemeral: const true` (remainingPercentage → UsedPercent, resetDate → ResetsAt map cleanly) or should irrlicht gain a copilot MetricsReader against the same authenticated usage API the CLI calls. A CONSUMED-credits burndown (totalNanoAiu, monotonic and already on disk) is a DIFFERENT and mappable assertion — it belongs to a future scenario row, not to this cap-relative one, and its checkpoint cadence is not per-turn (observed after turns 2 and 4 of a 4-turn session; 1, 3, 4, 5 of a 5-turn session; absent in two 1-turn sessions). SESSION IDENTITY (were it recorded): the interactive REPL mints a transient proc-<PID> pre-session born ready before $COPILOT_HOME/session-state/<id>/events.jsonl exists (the directory is created at launch but the log is not written until the first prompt), so the real session appears under a DIFFERENT id — hence the two-phase birth, with every later phase pinned via same_session_as. RECORDING WOULD ALSO NEED REAL CREDITS: under BYOK, the mode every other copilot cell records in, totalNanoAiu stays 0 and even the consumption counter is flat. OBSERVATIONS: model is left provisional for a recording to fill (copilot resolves 'auto' to a concrete id via session.auto_mode_resolved); tokens are non-zero from per-message outputTokens and cost is derived from the shared capacity price map.

Turn 2 settles to ready. DOCUMENTED TARGET: P2 ≥ P1 sampled at T2 > T1 — usage non-decreasing, snapshot freshly read rather than replayed stale. Unobservable today
